name: Verstraeten et al. 2023 data repository, virtual cohort of 500 synthetic stenotic aortic roots

split.method: Stratified by annulus band, 20% of each band hidden by largest remainder, seeded shuffle within band

rowToMesh.method: Row N of shapeFeatures.xlsx is Case_N.stl. Checked by fitting the mean of D_lvot, D_an, D_sinus and D_stj to the square root of each mesh's total triangle area.
rowToMesh.limit: Proves the ordering as a whole and catches outliers. Cannot detect a swap of two hearts of the same size.

assets: Dev hearts only: simplified meshes (meshopt GLB) and shaded thumbnails. Hidden hearts have measurements only.
